predicateScope: generic, source-bound literal selector glyph-only lists; no exam/qid allowlist

cases.rendererControlDisposition: preserveChoicePrefixes is currently true and would retain source glyph text in addition to the engine label; proposed change is explicit false.

implementationBindings.finding: The default/false path strips a leading marker from choice text and emits one engine-owned ①-⑤ ordinal. preserveChoicePrefixes=true retains text and duplicates that ordinal.
The current unconditional leading-circled-glyph rejection ignores ordered selector-only lists, renderer control, question body, image reference, and source evidence.
No existing tests cover a source-bound selector-only representation or its rejection boundaries.
Keep source choice exact parity and the engine-owned objective-choice label rule; a precise evidence-backed validator interpretation can preserve both.

genericPredicateProposal.choiceShape: choices must be exactly five nonempty strings, byte-equal and ordered as [①, ②, ③, ④, ⑤]. This predicate is structural and does not infer correctness of the answer.
genericPredicateProposal.displayControl: Allow only when preserveChoicePrefixes is false or omitted (current renderer default). Reject exception when true because that renders both source text marker and engine marker.
genericPredicateProposal.currentArtifactBinding: The evidence row qid must match; its choice hash must equal the current question choices; its sourceArchiveFile/sourceOrdinal/baseline raw SHA must match the current source-parity row; source choices must be explicitly recorded unchanged.
genericPredicateProposal.sourceReferenceBinding: Require one reviewed reference proof bound to the current source representation: QUESTION_CONTENT requires content hash match and the exact ordered marker sequence present in the student content; PROBLEM_ASSET requires the ref to equal an actual current image/visualAsset ref, the actual file SHA-256 to match evidence, opened=true/source fidelity exact, and an explicit reviewer observation of the exact ordered marker sequence in those pixels. The assigned assetRoot is used for the file check.
genericPredicateProposal.decision: Only suppress ARTIFACT_CHOICE_ENGINE_LABEL_DUPLICATED for members of this exact list when the full predicate passes. Retain empty/unknown/reordered/partial/extra/appended-marker failures and all ordinary objective label checks. No exam/qid-specific bypass.

requiredTestsForAuthorizedRepair: Positive content case: q7 ordered glyph-only array, false display flag, exact source/content hashes and source marker proof; allow only its five duplicate-label findings.

Positive asset case: q4 ordered glyph-only array, default-false display flag, current image ref+bytes SHA and observed ordered markers bound to opened exact source asset; allow only its five duplicate-label findings.
Negative: preserveChoicePrefixes=true, missing source reference, missing/failed marker observation, qid/baseline/choices/content/asset hash mismatch, or false source choice parity keeps rejection.

Negative: any appended text after a glyph, reordered/repeated/partial/extra/unknown/empty choices, or non-five list never matches the exception; existing empty and structural diagnostics remain active.

Focused validator unit tests in archive/tools/archive-stage-validator-artifact-v2.test.mjs; then CREATE generic validation for only authorized target bindings. R1/R2 source semantics and R3 actual render remain separate gates.
